audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 6 contradicted their own whys in both layers. Row 3 read Skill though whys[3] says his Courage stacking and Skaarl healing 'keep him ahead ... through Levels 4-5'; row 4 read Skill though whys[4] says 'he owns the level-6 all-in'; row 6 read Kled though whys[6] says the duel 'evens out'.
audit.why: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! travels 3500-4500 units and remounts him with a shield against a slow-advancing bramble wave, so level 6 is his. Late, his scaling stalls into your resists while your damage caps — that is even, not his.
audit.corrected: Row 3 -> Kled 3/10, row 4 -> Kled 3/10, row 6 -> Skill (rating unchanged). Matched full+content pairs, one atomic group. Matches the packet chart and the mirror's stated chart (Skill, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Skill) with the ratings inverted as required.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage was framed as a 'Bear Trap on a Rope cooldown window' with no numbers, and the level-6 row talked about Nature's Grasp rather than the ult that actually decides the stage.
audit.why: Bear Trap is 11/10/9/8/7s at 800 range; Jousting is 13-9s; Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110s at 3500/4000/4500. Your W is 11-12s through the mid stages. Those are the numbers that make the advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into tldr, winCon, phases[3].why, phases[4].why, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.
sources: ownerKit/enemyKit cooldowns and ranges in brief

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions the full layer never stated. (1) Bear Trap hooks first and only yanks you in if the shackle lasts — walking out of it denies the pull and the bonus physical damage. (2) Dismounted Kled deals LESS damage to champions and his Q becomes Pocket Pistol, which knocks him backwards. The full layer only said 'W-peel it' and 'Let him remount'.
audit.why: Riot text on Q: 'If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled', and the passive: 'While dismounted, Kled's abilities change and he deals less damage to champions'. The dismount is therefore your kill window, not merely something to prevent.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, tldr and winCon; the content layer already had the dismount idea in spikes[3] and wants.you[2] and now the full layer agrees with it.

edits.before: Passive heal + AA trades carry the early waves. Identify how Kled contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: A wash at 1 — his mounted Q and Skaarl autos beat your one ability, so last-hit and refuse the level-1 skirmish entirely.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope is down.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies gives him four fast attacks and Bear Trap yanks you in — do not trade until your W-Q is both online.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kled must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His dismount-remount sustain and bleed edge repeat trades even against Sap Magic — take only the trades he starts badly.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Courage stacking and Skaarl healing keep him ahead of your 11-12s W cadence through 4-5 — farm, hold the wave, and wait for a dismount.

edits.before: Nature’s Grasp roots whole teams — lane it only for kill windows. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kled's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! travels 3500-4500 and remounts him with a shield — he picks the all-in at 6, not your slow bramble wave.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown.
edits.after: His first item plus remount burst out-trades your tank line — fight only when Skaarl is already broken.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Kled carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Even: his scaling stalls into your resists but you cannot kill him. Carry threat 7/10 — pivot to Nature's Grasp teamfights.

edits.before: W-peel his pull — sustain up, root into Q. Maokai wins the Bear Trap on a Rope cooldown windows.
edits.after: Sidestep the 800-range Bear Trap, then hunt the dismount — on foot he deals less damage to champions.

edits.before: Peel his pull and out-sustain him. Track Bear Trap on a Rope before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Dodge Bear Trap (11-7s), out-sustain the bleed, and W-root him when Skaarl breaks — dismounted Kled cannot trade back.

edits.before: Kled wins by landing Bear Trap on a Rope, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Kled wins by landing Bear Trap, stacking Violent Tendencies autos through your resists, and remounting on R.

edits.before: His engage hook. W-peel it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Bear Trap is 11-7s at 800 range — sidestep it, then step up on him.

edits.before: Track Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope: His engage hook. W-peel it. When it is down — W-Q + R him.
edits.after: Bear Trap hooks, then yanks you in if it stays shackled — walk out of the leash or eat the second hit.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. W-peel it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — An 11-7s hook at 800 range. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
